{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data
penguins.info()

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:\n', penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of the two variables
print('\nSummary statistics for flipper_length_mm:\n', penguins['flipper_length_mm'].describe())
print('\nSummary statistics for body_mass_g:\n', penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())

# Check for implausible values
print('\nOutliers in flipper_length_mm (below 100 or above 300):', (penguins['flipper_length_mm'] < 100) | (penguins['flipper_length_mm'] > 300))
print('\nOutliers in body_mass_g (below 1000 or above 6000):', (penguins['body_mass_g'] < 1000) | (penguins['body_mass_g'] > 6000))"}
